# Workshop Extensions - Debuff Status Effects Reference Sheet

Source: [4864](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4864); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4864-n1"></a>

- Documented preview conventions: missing First Person means no first-person effect; missing Third Person means same as positioned effect or none; missing Friendly likely indicates first-person-only; Friendly without Enemy means shared appearances.

<a id="wiki-4864-n2"></a>

- Catalog covers Ana no-healing/sleep, Ashe burning particle/material, Cassidy stun, Mei freeze, Sigma flux target, Sombra hack start/loop, Widow venom target, Winston Tesla target and Zenyatta discord target.

<a id="wiki-4864-n3"></a>

- Asset applicability can differ by first-person/third-person/friendly/enemy viewing context; same effect label is not guaranteed to produce all visual variants.

Source limitations:

- Some absence semantics are explicitly ambiguous ('either','likely'); do not turn missing preview into definite engine capability.

- November 2024 metadata, remote previews not viewed. Effect names may survive retired abilities; asset availability needs current enum confirmation.

Offline scope: Remote visual/audio previews are not available as offline factual text. Behavioral notes and named API assets are retained; no visual matching or numeric bounds are inferred from absent media.
